item.title: Call Witness — Privacy Policy
item.description: Version: 1.0 · Effective date: set at launch Developed by SGAIL Labs Who we are Call Witness is a trust-verification assistant developed by SGAIL Labs. We help users assess the risk of suspicious phone calls and recommend safe next steps. Contact: christopher_howard@live.com Website: https://sentinelproject.ai What this policy covers This policy explains what data Call Witness collects, how we use it, and what choices you have. Short version: almost nothing leaves your device.
